notes.title: Onboarding Improvement patch!
notes.content:
FIRST BLADE

 Default blade, easier/weaker Awaken (low speed only)
 Targets new players, easier to learn other game mechanics (before focusing on Awaken)
 Main unlocked at level 3 (previously first blade)
 Legendary unlocked at level 15 (previously 10)
 First Blade replace Legacy (underused), same visual.


TRIALS

 Trials are challenges that aim at orienting player toward how to play their character
 Winning trial with good score give a lot of XP, making blade progression easier
 Added the Trials mode in Dojo and before Ranked match (replace Training)


PERFORMANCE

 Better networking (should make low lag game feel a bit more smooth)


SOLO

 Viking, Pirate and Ronin can now be adversaries in Solo
 Reworked fighting behavior (more diversity, adjusted difficulty)
 Menu flow slightly improved
 Animations now blend between each other
 Opponent orient itself toward the player
 Apprentice mode was made easier and to feel more like a real match


IK

 Better character IK mean body position is better oriented with head and hands


DOJO

 Menu flow slightly improved
 Can now skip some Tutorial sequence


PROGRESSION

 Added UI to see progression toward next sword (only in trials)

notes.title: Ronin Update is here!
notes.content:
Greeting, fearless warriors!

Get ready to unsheathe your excitement, because a thrilling new update is now LIVE on Broken Edge! As the shadows lengthen, a subtle rustle stirs through the bamboo groves – a whisper that heralds the arrival of a new fighter, a lone wanderer whose skills are as sharp as his katana.

Embark on a journey back to the land of the rising sun with this new free update! ⛩️ Discover all the details in the breakdown below:


What's new?


 The Ronin
Once a devoted Samurai, this new fighter now roams through cities and countryside in search of worthy adversaries. With a sheath as his ally and a katana as his soulmate, the Ronin brings a unique martial style to learn and master. His mechanics of combat are inspired by anime sword fighting. So, get ready to feel cool as you unsheathe your blade  and slice through your opponent in the blink of an eye. Omae wa mou shindeiru!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505119/4223ab183406e9678ae7b976a9a3f39b82f71fa5.png

 New Arena
Fight like no other in a shrine hidden deep within the heart of a forest. Let the rustling bamboo and the full moon bear witness to your victories, as you carve your path to glory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505119/a15441f0a37686a8c2a0134baeebbd5eb50661a6.png


Join our Discord server  to connect with other players, share your strategies, and stay up-to-date on the latest news. You can also join a guild, participate in Leagues, and maybe reach the Tournaments! 

The path of the Ronin is yours to tread – will you rise to the challenge? Sharpen your blade, and let your journey begin! ⚔️

notes.title: LET’S TALK ABOUT BROKEN EDGE
notes.content:
Dear warriors and Steam players,

We hope this message finds you well and still enjoying the thrill of the fight in Broken Edge. Today, we have news to share that reflects our commitment to the game, its community, and its future. We want to be upfront and honest about a decision we've made, and we genuinely hope you understand our perspective!

Keeping the Momentum

Since launch, we've taken great pride in delivering numerous free updates to enhance your gameplay. These updates weren't just about adding new features and fighters; they were our way of saying "thank you" for your unwavering support. With each new addition, we aimed to provide fresh excitement and depth to your duels.

Here's a glimpse of some of the free updates we've released:
- Persian Update (December, 2022): new fighter ; new arena ; voice chat ; leaderboard.
- The Forge (January, 2023): public test server to try new content before their release. 
- Viking Update (February, 2023): new fighter ; new arena ; server selection.
- Pirate Update (May, 2023): new fighter ; new arena ; multi-blade feature.
- Upcoming Ronin Update (September, 2023): new fighter ; new arena ; PSVR 2 launch. 
- MORE TO COME before the end of 2023. But it’s a surprise for the moment. 

The enthusiasm we've seen within the community has been incredibly rewarding, and we're deeply thankful for your involvement in making Broken Edge a living game. 

A New Price

With the ongoing development and maintenance of Broken Edge comes a set of challenges. After careful consideration, we've made the tough decision to adjust the price of the game to $14.99, starting September 5th, 10AM PT. This change will help us sustain the game's quality, offer more content, and provide the support you deserve.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505119/40bb376d704ff649c11caeca46aa40e908f3e665.png

Seize the moment

We value your commitment and want to make sure you have a chance to seize the current pricing before the adjustment takes effect. Until September 5th 10AM PT, you can purchase Broken Edge at the initial price of $9.99.

A Heartfelt Thank You

The road we've traveled with Broken Edge has been filled with thrilling battles, memorable moments, and shared victories. We're thankful for every player who has made this journey with us, and we're committed to ensuring that the fight continues.

We truly appreciate your understanding, and we're grateful to have you as a part of our community.

See you in the arena, 

TREBUCHET & Fast Travel Games

Secure Broken Edge at $9.99 now.

But there’s more! See the full breakdown of the update:

notes.title: The Forge - Public Test Server!
notes.content:
Want to test the Viking and other brand new contents before their official release? We’re excited to announce: The Forge! This public test version of Broken Edge is aimed to validate upcoming fighters, mechanics, balancing and other adjustments. 

The Forge relies on your benevolent participation. Test, have fun, and share your feedback on Discord! This will help us craft the best game experience for you, fearsome warriors!

We’ll reach out to you on Discord when there are novelties to try out, so be sure to acquire the Blacksmith role on the platform. 

The Forge is accessible now to all the Broken Edge players! 

How to access The Forge? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505119/9299f5cb57368009ef8d9aca114cb58cc19f1973.png

Then click on Beta in the menu to the right of the pop up window. Select ‘’The Forge’’ in the drop-down list. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505119/9b18b1e6067b34239b9f3d91000b32abae3b7904.png

Now, you just need to update your game on Steam to play in The Forge! Select ‘’None’’ in the same menu to return to the original game later. 


How to become a Blacksmith on Discord? 

To share your feedback, you can earn the Blacksmith role on our official Discord server. To do so, join the community and click on the emoji in the #blacksmith-self-role channel! You now have unlocked a new section where you can access our latest Forged announcements and leave all your comments!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505119/8f47d1406b539c456643cb96992331690b22e4f6.png

PS: You may encounter bugs and unfinished features on The Forge as it’s a testing server! :) 

See you in The Forge!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 is live!
notes.content:
Welcome to the patch 1.1.1 that concludes 2022! To prepare for the new year we are fixing some features and adding tools to identify the origin of the latency issue. We can assure you, we are working hard on it to guarantee that only your skills will lead you to victory!  

Thanks for this amazing launch and we’re looking forward to dueling you in 2023! 

Balancing
Tyrant
The Tyrant is a formidable fighter… but he deserves to become even more frightful!
	Buff:  + 10 awaken

Knight
We may have overbuffed the Knight during the last update! Time to blunt his blade a little bit.
Nerf: Threshold to maintain awaken becomes more demanding

Integration of latency (ping) investigation tools
To fight against the lagging problem, we’re implementing tools to identify the reasons behind this issue. We’ll be able to collect additional games’ data and analyze them in order to fix the latency as soon as possible!  

Calibration
Players can no more artificially extend their arms during the calibration phase. That will help to prevent cheating or trolling tactics. 

ELO Improvement
We modified the Elo so it won’t become negative but stop at 0. Every player above 2500 Elo will be reset to 2500 Elo.
We made some adjustments to the rating algorithm. These changes will affect   matches with a high Elo difference. This means that the amount of points you gain/lose will be way more affected by the Elo difference between you and your opponent than before.
